text: Drive REVEL S.L., the Spanish car-subscription company behind the REVEL brand, was co-founded by Enrique de Mateo (CEO) and Daniel Marcos; in September 2023 it raised a EUR 115 million package in which KKR and Santander Consumer Finance entered its shareholding for EUR 15 million of equity, at undisclosed percentages, with no state identified among its investors.

source.name: TechCrunch: Spanish car subscription startup Revel raises $123M
source.quote: The funding is a combination of debt and equity: €100 million is structured financing earmarked to build out the car network, and €15 million is equity invested in the business itself. Investors include KKR, Santander Consumer Finance

additionalSources.name: El Confidencial: Revel, el renting low cost que apunta a los jóvenes, levanta 115 millones
additionalSources.quote: la firma de capital riesgo KKR y Banco de Santander, a través de su unidad Santander Consumer Finance , aportarán en total 15 millones de euros, entrando en el accionariado de Revel (no han desvelado a cambio de qué porcentaje)
